biggest_catch: The company itself publishes no concrete payout terms on its official site — no per-survey rate, no point-to-dollar conversion, no cashout minimum — so every payout figure in the catalog traces only to third-party reviews, which is below the verification bar (same reason R0213 Nielsen was rejected).
catches: Official page states only that surveys earn points 'redeemed for cash through Paypal' or Amazon gift certificates — no rate, conversion, or minimum published by the company.
All numeric terms in circulation (1 point = $0.10, PayPal cashout at 100 points = $10, gift cards at 50 points = $5, average survey ~10 points) come from third-party reviews, not Opinion Outpost.
Third-party reviews report frequent screenouts after 10+ minutes of unpaid screening time.
Age 18+ rule is reported by third parties; not confirmed on the official page.

c1.evidence: Real operating survey panel with a live official site (opinionoutpost.com); About page describes the paid-survey program in the company's own words.

c2.evidence: FAILED: the official About page contains no concrete payout terms — no points-per-survey figure, no point-to-dollar conversion, and no minimum cashout threshold. Every numeric figure (1 pt = $0.10, PayPal 100 pts = $10, gift cards 50 pts = $5) is sourced only from third-party reviews.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee; sign-up is described as free on the official page and in reviews.

eligibility: Age 18+ reported by third-party sources only; not stated on the official page. US/UK/CA panels exist per third-party reviews.
notes: Official page loaded live 2026-09-23. It publishes the payout MECHANISM (points redeemable for PayPal cash and Amazon gift certificates) but zero numbers — no rate, no conversion, no threshold. Third-party sources agree on 1 point = $0.10, 100 points = $10 PayPal minimum, 50 points = $5 gift cards, average survey ~10 points, but none of that is company-published, so this cannot verify under the strict criteria.

s2.note: No fees to join reported; no fee information on the official page.

s3.note: No payout timing stated on the official page; third-party reviews mention up to 72 hours for PayPal.
